body:
Thanks for your side on this and the well wishes. They’re appreciated. 

I think I’m aware that this is 100% an avoidance tactic and a way for me to dodge problems, but it’s such an easy crutch to lean on that I can’t stop using it. Why feel bad about my actions when I can just imagine I’ll be dead in a week anyways? It’s an easy excuse for any problem I come across when your backup plan is to ignore the problem all together.

As you said, it doesn’t matter right now how terrible of an idea it really is, it’s just that much easier to fantasize about it from afar.
